title: NYCU
description: Do you know much about NYCU? As an NYCU student, can you recognize all the locations correctly? Test it out!

title: World
description: Embark on a journey that takes you all over the world. From the most desolate roads in Australia to the busy, bustling streets of New York City.

title: Famous Places
description: The world is full of breathtaking wonders, from natural marvels to iconic landmarks. How many can you recognize?

title: Taiwan
description: Visit the spicy, scenic island of Taiwan. Keep your eyes open as you cover everything from isolated cycle trails to the pulsating streets of Taipei. This place offers some truly awe-inspiring panoramas and who knows where you might end up.

title: Asia
description: Asia — a land of diverse cultures, incredible landscapes, and age-old traditions. From the ancient temples of Angkor Wat to the bustling streets of Tokyo, this map promises a geographical journey like no other!

title: United States
description: From the Atlantic to the Pacific, 50 states of endless landscapes - how well do you know them?

title: Japan
description: No other country in the world is possibly as associated with both history and future at the same time as Japan. The land of the rising sun, manga and pokémon. On a clear day Mount Fuji can be seen from the capital Tokyo - perhaps that will aid you in your journey?

title: United Kingdom
description: The British Isles, home for 30,000 years, are known for history, rock legends, fish 'n' chips, and plenty of rain!

title: France
description: Visit the #1 tourist destination in the world! It doesn't matter if you're a foodie, history buff or a culture vulture. You can spend a lifetime here, and there will still be stuff left to see. Bonjour!

title: Spain
description: Everywhere from the Pyrenees to the snowcapped Sierra Nevada that rises up from the sun-baked plains of Andalucia, you'll find villages of timeless beauty.

title: Germany
description: Welcome to Germany! Put the pedal to the metal on Autobahn, the highways where there’s no speed limit. For some fun settle down in Munich at the end of September and beginning of October for the Oktoberfest - a beer festival and carnival!

title: Türkiye
description: The major city of Istanbul is unique because it’s built over two continents, Europe and Asia. Türkiye has a long history which vouches for great excursions. Come along!

title: Canada
description: Whether you’re a hard-core adrenaline junkie looking for a backcountry adventure, an explorer on a big road trip or just want to experience the city pulse; The Great White North ticks all the boxes.

title: Poland
description: Poland is located at a geographic crossroads that links the forested lands of northwestern Europe to the sea lanes of the Atlantic Ocean. A nation with a proud cultural heritage and with roots back over 1,000 years.

title: Italy
description: The food, the history and the picturesque villages. Bring a guide book and navigate the country with the world record in UNESCO World Heritage Sites, great pasta and many soothing vineyards!

title: Russia
description: Давайте рассмотрим Россию! Russia covers eleven time zones, two continents and is the largest country in the world. A whole new world is waiting for you to be discovered.

title: Brazil
description: Soccer, samba and the Amazon. The world's fifth largest country, bordering almost all of the South American countries.

title: Europe
description: Explore Europe’s diversity! From Spain’s fiery festivals to Norway’s serene fjords, uncover culture, history, and beauty. How close will your guess be?

title: Australia
description: The home of the kangaroo and the koala, the vast outback and the great barrier reef. It's the world's smallest continent but also the planet's sixth largest country. Welcome to the land down under!

title: Indonesia
description: Located right at the Ring of Fire, Indonesia has some of the most active volcanoes in the world. Sounds a bit too adventurous? Indonesia is a large country and the archipelago consists of over 17 000 thousand islands, among those are beachy Bali and Java, home to buzzing capital of Jakarta.

title: Netherlands
description: Discover the many secrets of this beautiful country with its canal towns and windmills. Bike past fields of tulips, pretty canals and church spires as you go.

title: India
description: India became the world’s most populous country in 2024, with over 700 languages spoken but only 22 officially recognized. Time to brush up on your Hindi!

title: Sweden
description: Sweden is known for the Nobel Prize, IKEA, meatballs, and cold winters. It’s also the third largest country in Europe by size—and the birthplace of GeoGuessr.

title: Switzerland
description: Switzerland produces and eats more chocolate than any other country! Stroll the cobbled streets of the Old Town in the capital city of Bern or visit the science city of Genève. Come along - and don’t forget the chocolate!

title: Norway
description: Norway is famed for its mountains and spectacular fjord coastline, as well as its history as a seafaring power. About two-thirds of Norway is mountainous, and off its much-indented coastline lie, carved by deep glacial fjords, some 50,000 islands.

title: Ukraine
description: Pripyat in northern Ukraine is perhaps the most famous ghost town after the Chernobyl nuclear power plant disaster in 1986. Nowadays, there are guided tours of the area, although radiation levels are still high.

title: Argentina
description: From the towering Andes in the west to the great Atlantic in the east. Spanning from the lush never-ending plains of the Pampas to the pulsating, soccer-loving cities in between!

title: Finland
description: Finland´s coast boasts the world´s largest archipelago and the lakes here are some of the cleanest. Visitors can also witness the northern lights, which appear more than 200 nights a year in Finnish Lapland.

title: New Zealand
description: The land of kiwis - name of a fruit, a native bird and a nickname for the people of New Zealand. For the adrenaline junkie, rafting, bungy jumping and snowboarding are some of the multitudes of thrill seeking activities. Get out of those jandals, bring a stubbie and enjoy the ride!

title: Ireland
description: Ireland, the Emerald Isle is the third-largest in Europe. Bring out your green! St. Patrick’s Day is packed with parades, good luck charms, and all things green. The event started as a religious holiday, but over time it’s become a celebration of Irish culture.

title: Denmark
description: Once brutal Vikings, now one of the world's most peaceful societies. The southernmost of the Scandinavian nations known for smørrebrød, the Roskilde festival and Tivoli Gardens.

title: Mexico
description: Explore Mexico’s cenotes, the Yucatán Peninsula, Mayan ruins in Chiapas, and its 59 varieties of corn!

title: Greece
description: Welcome to sunny Hellas! Enjoy traditional dances, Mediterranean cuisine, and ancient ruins—but leave your high heels at home, as they’re banned at historic sites!

title: Hungary
description: Famous for Rubik’s Cube, SPA and thermal baths, but did you know there are cowboys in Hungary? At the Great Hungarian Plain there are herdsman called csikósok. So, what are you waiting for - giddy up and visit the town of Hortobágy for some more information!

title: Romania
description: Romania boasts the world’s heaviest building, largest flag, and the scenic Transfăgărășan Highway. It also holds fun records like the longest sausage and biggest bowl of goulash!

title: Portugal
description: Live out your own fairytale fantasy in the town of Sintra with colorful castles and castle ruins. Take an old school trolley ride to Praia das Maçãs beaches, surf a bit, sunbathe and have some really fresh fish at the restaurants.

title: Serbia
description: The former core republic of Yugoslavia is now a landlocked country in the central part of the Balkan Peninsula in Southeastern Europe. Did you know Serbia won the 2020 GeoGuessr world cup?

title: Belgium
description: Along with waffles, beer and moules-frites, albeit a tiny country Belgium has three official languages and houses more than 11 million inhabitants. For some political action, The European Union headquarters are located in the capital of Brussels as well as NATO headquarters.

title: Thailand
description: A kingdom in Southeast Asia - the Land of a Thousand Smiles, this country attracts tourists from all over the world. White sand beaches, snorkeling and festivals are some of the activities to participate in while in Thailand. As long as you follow the local rules of having underwear on when leaving the house and a shirt on while driving - you’re ready to explore!

title: Israel
description: Home to three world religions the capital city of Jerusalem is sacred to the Abrahamic religions with several significant sites, while the Mediterrean city of Tel Aviv is a technology hotspot. Take on an adventure and visit historic places and Bauhaus architecture!

title: Croatia
description: Croatia offers Zadar’s sea organ, a sunset praised by Hitchcock, and Hum, the world’s smallest town with just 20 residents!

title: Austria
description: The Alps! The scenery! The classical music! The inventions! We all have Austria and Austrians to thank for inventions like the sewing machine and alkaline battery, as well as composers like Mozart, Haydn and Schubert, to name a few. Winter sports and in particular alpine skiing is a go-to activity thanks to the neighbouring The Alps.

title: Czech Republic
description: This central European country with over 2000 castles was once was a hotspot of the Holy Roman Empire - the capital city of Prague was even home to the Holy Roman Emperor Charles IV! Even though Prague is a city full of historical sights, don’t miss the kind of creepy Sedlec Ossuary, a bone church east of Prague. The chandelier is said to incorporate every human bone in the body at least once…

title: Chile
description: Stay cool in the Atacama, the world’s driest desert, or explore vibrant Valparaíso with Chilean wine. Spot penguins along the coast and southern islands in this amazing country!

title: Bulgaria
description: Welcome to The land of roses, the fragrance from the Rose Valley is eminent throughout May to June - or, seaside resort around the Black Sea - Sunny Beach is one of plenty options.

title: Colombia
description: Tune in to The land of a thousand rhythms and bring those salsa moves. Cumbia is the national dance of Colombia but there are many more. To keep up, have a cup or two of Colombian coffee, which of many is considered to be the best coffee in the world!

title: South Korea
description: A hi-tech hub hosting an abundance of everything K! For music, turn to K-pop, for food you got kalbi, kimchi and kongguksu and for skincare, well there’s K-beauty - take your time, the routines are extensive. Or for a quicker, but deep dive version of skincare, simply visit the Boryeong Mud Festival with Mud Experience Land as its centerpiece.

title: Malaysia
description: Cash is king and remember to drive on the left side in this equatorial country in Southeast Asia. Penang Island is considered the food capital of Asia so stroll down the streets of George Town for a tasty, delicious experience!

title: Singapore
description: Located almost upon the equator, Singapore’s temperatures usually range from 28-34 degrees Celsius all year round and feels like summer all year round. Once a British colonial trading post, today a thriving global financial hub. Spit out your chewing gum (but not on the ground), grab a Singapore sling and explore the land of shopping malls.

title: Hong Kong
description: The special administrative region of China. 7.5 million people of various nationalities live here making this small coastal city one of the most densely populated cities in the world. Known for the impressive skylines, the Big Buddha and an entrepreneurial spirit. Welcome to Hong Kong!

title: Philippines
description: Hop on a colorful jeepney in the capital of Manila and go explore the oldest Chinatown in the world and historical buildings like Manila City Hall and the San Agustin Church. Drink a cooling halo-halo to get a full Filipino cuisine experience.

title: Slovakia
description: Located in one of the geographical midpoints of Europe (depending on how you count) Slovakia has more than 6000 caves and diverse nature. Visit the High Tatras mountains with glacier lakes and peaks at 2500 meters above sea level and mineral springs in one of many spa resorts.

title: Lithuania
description: Lithuania is a land of contrasts, from medieval castles rising over lakes to endless stretches of pine forest. Wander through Vilnius’ old town, a maze of cobbled streets and baroque churches, or head out to the Curonian Spit, a strip of shifting sand dunes and sea views that feels like another world.

title: Africa
description: Embark on a journey through Africa—a continent rich in history and diverse landscapes. From Egypt's ancient pyramids to South Africa's vibrant cities and Kenya's vast savannas, can you guess each location on the map?

title: South Africa
description: Did you know South Africa has three capitals? Pretoria is the executive capital, Cape Town the legislative capital and Bloemfontein the judicial capital. The world’s longest wine route stretches through Cape Wineland - drive along the beautiful rolling hills and savor the breathtaking landscape!

title: Iceland
description: Iceland is a country of sharp contrasts. A place where fire and ice co-exist. Enjoy 24 hours daylight during the summer, indulge in the beautiful colours of the arctic vegetation in autumn and become mystified by the Northern lights during winter time.

title: South America
description: Embark on a journey through South America—a continent of breathtaking beauty and vibrant cultures. From the Amazon rainforest's lush depths to the towering peaks of the Andes and the ancient ruins of Machu Picchu, can you guess each location on the map?

title: Slovenia
description: A buzzing beekeeper’s gem! Beekeeping is an old tradition in Slovenia and 0.5% of the population are beekeepers - even children can attend beekeeping courses in school. Come along for a sweet tour!

title: Estonia
description: Marvel at the Old Town of Tallinn with alleyways dating back to the 13th century and visit medieval churches. For a more relaxed stay, head to the coast for several spa towns and enjoy the beaches and archipelago!

title: Latvia
description: The capital of Riga has a myriad of Art Nouveau buildings making it an interesting architectural destination. For more exciting architecture as well as some beautiful shallow beaches, head to the city of Jūrmala. Latvia is a gem for nature addicts as over 50% of the country is pure wilderness - so tie those hiking boots and get exploring!

title: Peru
description: The Lost city of Machu Picchu is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, a place where Incan civilization once resided. It’s built on a mountain ridge 2430 meteres above sea level and the only way to get there is to hike. More of an animal person? Alpacas and the Peruvian Inca Orchid Dog, which sometimes is called the ugliest dog in the world, are common here.

title: North America
description: Discover North America — a land of stunning landscapes and rich cultures. From Canada's snowy mountains to the ancient ruins of Mexico, and the bustling streets of New York City, this map takes you on an unforgettable journey. How close can you guess each location?

title: Madagascar
description: Lemurs, Antananarivo and baobab - welcome to Madagascar! Lemurs are native only to Madagascar and might very well be the most famous residents of the island. Capital city Antananarivo, or Tana for short, offers plenty of historical sites like the palace Rova Manjakamiadana situated on top of the mountain Analamanga. And if you come across huge baobab trees on your travels, remember that most are endemic to Madagascar.

title: Uruguay
description: With coast toward the Atlantic Ocean and a unique location, Uruguay is the only country in South America situated entirely south of the Tropic of Capricorn. Explore the capital city of Montevideo and visit a steakhouse - parrillas - to try asado, an open-fire barbecue. Dig in and enjoy a typical Uruguyan meal!

title: Ecuador
description: Ecuador is named from it’s geographical position at the equator and as a result the sun rises at 6 o’clock AM and sets at 6 o’clock PM - every single day. Darwin’s discoveries at the Galápagos Islands lives on with Ecuador being a megadiverse country with many endemic bird species. Bring the binoculars and bird checklist and get going!

title: Albania
description: Look out for families walking and talking in the streets during early evenings - this tradition called xhiro is a welcomed break outside away from the daytime heat. And remember, nod for no and shake your head for yes, this might be especially good to remember after your first raki!

title: Luxembourg
description: Over a 100 castles fits in this teeny-tiny country landlocked in Western Europe - and with castles follows, of course, medieval festivals. One of them being at the castle of Vianden, a festival with fighting knights, music and jugglers, and much more!

title: Greenland
description: Greenland is the largest island on Earth and most of it’s sparse, mostly Inuit, population of 56 000 inhabitants lives in the southwestern part of the island. Did you know Greenland actually was green about 2.5 million years ago? Now most of the island is covered in glaciers, ice and snow - and roads outside of towns are rare. Join us and travel above the Arctic Circle at 66°North for a dogsledding tour!

title: Puerto Rico
description: This tropical count… Oh, that's right! Puerto Rico is not a sovereign country but a commonwealth governed by the United States. Bring your hiking boots and hit the blue cobblestones in Old San Juan, take to the green tropical rainforest El Yunque (look up, it might rain frogs!) and end the day kayaking in the blue bioluminescent Mosquito Bay.

title: Mongolia
description: Better be driving a 4WD with some spare tires when going outside of Ulaanbaatar since most of the roads are gravel and dirt roads - or, perhaps a horse trekking tour could be a fun way of discovering the country? Horses are part of everyday life for many Mongolians and there are as many horses as inhabitants!

title: North Macedonia
description: Landlocked in the seismic region of the Balkan Peninsula, North Macedonia has one of the oldest and deepest lakes in the world, one of the oldest astronomic observatories and the deepest underwater cave! For you rocks and mineral fans out there - North Macedonia was home to the only active thallium mine in the world, and - with a bit of luck you can find a raspberry colored ruby around the city of Prilep.

title: Monaco
description: The Principality of Monaco is a tiny microstate on the French Riviera, with the area being 2.1 square kilometers it is the second smallest sovereign state in the world. Stroll across the nation and enjoy architecture from the 13th century blend with luxurious modern design, attractions like the Prince's Palace, the Monte-Carlo casino and the Princess Grace Rose Garden, named after Grace Kelly.

title: United Arab Emirates
description: Next stop - United Arab Emirates, home to the world largest tower called Burj Khalifa. Rather fitting with Geography, the World Islands are located off the coast of Dubai. An archipelago of small islands constructed in the shape of the World. If you are into photography you can also visit Al-Hajar Mountains, the highest mountain in the UAE. Or just relax with some Arabic Coffee and a portion of Luqaimat and plan your next activity.

title: Tunisia
description: Welcome to Tunisia, a country with lots of history, from ancient Carthage for example. And do you know what the village of Matmata has that attracts architectural buffs, folklore and history geeks as well as Star Wars nerds? Indigenous underground homes called troglodytes burrowed into the rock! How does Star Wars fit into this? Luke Skywalker lived in a troglodyte! Get your archaeologist hat on and let's get digging!

title: Montenegro
description: Enjoy the green Mediterranean climate by the ocean and full on ski weather in the mountains on the same day! Montenegro is located in four climate zones which allows for diverse weather. Come here for the 117 beaches, lots of coffee and scenic routes!

title: Kazakhstan
description: The Great Steppe, nomadic culture, beshbarmak, and brisk winters - Kazakhstan is renowned for its vast array of unique features. As the ninth largest country in the world and the largest landlocked one, its sprawling landscapes range from deserts to high mountains. Home to the Baikonur Cosmodrome, the world's first and largest space launch facility, Kazakhstan is a place where ancient traditions meet futuristic innovations. Welcome to the heart of Central Asia!

title: Guatemala
description: Guatemala derives from the Nahualtl word Quuahtlemallan meaning “the land of trees” and the country certainly lives up to the name with a plethora of national parks ranging from mangrove forests, natural caves and lagoons, to Tikal National Park. This was the first mixed UNESCO World Heritage site, which means that cultural as well as natural wonders are included. In this case - Maya ruins in the jungle.

title: Faroe Islands
description: The green, however unwooded Faroe Islands are an autonomous territory within the Kingdom of Denmark and is located northwest of Scotland and halfway between Iceland and Norway. These islands boast volcanic landscapes with no place farther than five kilometers from the ocean. Not only showing off natural beauty and sparse between fast food restaurants, but also puffins, and sheep grazing on roofs.

title: Bolivia
description: From cold and extreme altitudes in the Andes to humid and tropical climate in the lowlands, Bolivia is a biodiverse country. Although not capital city, the government city of La Paz is named “The highest capital in the world” at 3640 meters above sea level. Bring your oxygen and let’s acclimate to the high altitudes!

title: Malta
description: Consisting of seven islands, beautiful beaches and being a diver's paradise, Malta has something for all you sun and sea worshippers out there. And there are a lot, about three times more tourists than residents visit the Maltese islands - come along and join the fun in the sun!

title: Dominican Republic
description: Part of the Greater Antilles and situated, and sharing, the Hispaniola island with Haiti, the Dominican Republic is a popular vacation hotspot. Golf, beaches, merengue and bachata, stunning views and waterfalls - there are plenty of reasons to visit this Caribbean pearl.

title: Bangladesh
description: Head off the beaten track and visit the lush country of Bangladesh. Home to large river deltas, UNESCO sites such as the Sundarbans Mangrove Forest, Mosque City Bagerhat and once the second largest Buddhist monastery of Somapuri Mahabhihara. Take a stroll along Cox’s Bazar, the longest unbroken sandy beach in the world - 125 km in length!

title: Vietnam
description: Travel to capital Hanoi in the north for a traditional Vietnamese experience, temples, markets and pho - or to the bustling Ho Chi Minh City in the south for a more diverse experience with French culture influences. For a more unwinding trip, head to the breathtaking Hang Son Doong cave and Ban Gioc waterfall.

title: Nigeria
description: As the most populated country in Africa and one of the most populous countries in the world, Nigeria is about as multicultural as a country gets with over 500 indigenous languages spoken and over 250 ethnic groups living here! Abuja is the capital city, however Lagos is the largest. Get your art glasses on and check out some art shops and museums.

title: Kyrgyzstan
description: Welcome to Kyrgyzstan! A landlocked mountainous country in Central Asia boasting eleven national parks. Saddle up - horse riding is a national sport, how about a round of oodarysh? That would be wrestling from horsebacks - a sport featured in the World Nomad Games.

title: Botswana
description: The world’s most elephant dense country is found in landlocked Botswana, where also a unique near-quadripoint comes together - the four borders of Namibia, Botswana, Zambia and Zimbabwe. Come along and roam right through the national parks - don’t be surprised if you see a few of the Big Five!

title: Oceania
description: Embark on a journey through Oceania — a land of stunning landscapes and unique wildlife. From Australia's vibrant cities and red deserts to New Zealand's majestic mountains and serene lakes, can you guess each location on the map?

title: Jordan
description: Explore Petra, one of the seven wonders of the world while setting out for The Jordan Trail, a 650 km epic hike across the country! Linger a couple of days in the capital city of Amman, revel in street food from the Levant region while enjoying graffiti covered staircases all over the city!

title: Isle of Man
description: Known as Mann, an island in the Irish Sea, is quite the conundrum! Not belonging to the United Kingdom in any way but being a Crown Dependency. For more quirky - come along and ride the rolling green hills, but, keep an eye out for multi-horned Loagthan sheep and tailless Manx cats!

title: Sri Lanka
description: Do you have the guts to climb the Ambuluwawa Tower? This 48 meters tall cone-shaped tower is truly unique. If you do not feel like an adventure Sri Lanka offers not only beautiful beaches but also exciting wildlife. Did you know this Island have the biggest concentration of leopards in the wild? Grab a cup of Ceylon tea and start exploring!

title: Guam
description: Welcome fellow explorer to Guam. On this breathtaking island you can experience some world-class snorkeling and amazing beaches. Is that not your cup of tea? No worries! Why not visit the Gef Pa'go Chamorro Cultural Village where you can submerge yourself into the Chamorro culture. Or you can also partake in eating a portion of Kadon Pika, a local stew. Psst! It is pretty spicy so take it easy.

title: Cambodia
description: Put both palms together as a lotus flower to learn the greeting sampeah and forget about the handshake or wave. Get the haggling skill in order, smile and go to town at the markets, like the one in Siem Reap. From there Angkor Wat is nearby, the world’s largest religious monument!

title: Andorra
description: Hola, bon dia! Merci! Buried in the Pyrenees, wedged between Spain and France, Andorra is the only country that has Catalan as an only official language. Andorra is not a member of the European Union nor the currency Euro zone but bring Euros anyway, it’s the go-to currency since the franc and peseta era came to an end. After browsing around this small principality you may notice a lot of old-timers - the life expectancy here are among the highest in the world. However, this place is made for outdoorsy activities, ski-in or ski-out, just be sure to enjoy the views along the way!

title: Kenya
description: Yes, Kenya is The Place to be for an ultimate wildlife experience and to get up and, well, kind of close with the big five… or even the big nine. But do you know of the marine five? Sip a chai and plan a coastal trip - the dolphins and whales are awaiting!

title: Christmas Island
description: Christmas Island is located in the Indian Ocean and is an Australian external territory, though actually closer to Asia than to mainland Australia. As home to millions of bright red land crabs know that navigating your car, or other way of transport, around them takes some extra time so keep that in mind while traveling through this fascinating island.

title: Qatar
description: Welcome to The State of Qatar within the Arabian peninsula surrounded by the Persian Gulf.

title: Senegal
description: The capital city of Dakar offers vibrant markets, a busy seaport and is known for formerly being the finish line of the Dakar Rally. The island Fadiouth is entirely made out of seashells and is found along the coast. Senegal can also boast with having a pink lake. This is a place to see - come along!

title: Jersey
description: The largest of the Channel Islands and a Crown Dependency located near the coast of Normandy, Jersey boasts one of the largest tidal ranges in the world - low tide and the island nearly doubles in size! Say hi to the crapauds, wear your best woollen jersey and come explore this fascinating island!

title: San Marino
description: The microstate of San Marino is the world’s fifth smallest country and with no railroad or airport the only way to enter this picturesque nation is to travel by car or bus from Rimini in Italy. Climb (or cable car) Mount Titano, visit two of the three ancient towers of San Marino for grand views!

title: Laos
description: In the Land of a Million Elephants you might not see so many elephants but perhaps get a glimpse of the Irrawaddy dolphins or a Black Crested Gibbon while exploring the natural beauty of the country. If you're noticing a lot of French street names or bakeries in a Southeast Asian setting while traveling through - consider Laos being your destination.

title: Uganda
description: Consider yourself a twitcher? Well, you probably already know that 11% of the world’s bird species are found in Uganda. If not, now you know - and you can go ahead and twitch away! And keep an eye out for mountain gorillas if you head to the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Bwindi Impenetrable National Park. Grab a rolex to go, no, not the watch but the omelette wrapped in a chapatti bread, tread lightly around the butterflies and enjoy this landlocked East African country!

title: Lebanon
description: On the Mediterranean coast, Lebanon offers a unique blend of cultural heritage and natural beauty. From Baalbek’s grand Roman temples to Beirut’s nightlife and the iconic cedar forests, every visit is unforgettable.

title: Gibraltar
description: The tiny British Overseas Territory is located in the southern tip of Spain. Famous for natural wonders like the Rock of Gibraltar and underground sea caves, animal life like being home to the only wild monkey population in Europe and a birdwatcher's paradise - Gibraltar offers an eclectic mix of Mediterranean and British lifestyles!

title: Ghana
description: Agoo! That’s hello in Twi, one of plenty of languages spoken in Ghana. Located in West Africa the geography is diverse, spanning from savannahs to tropical rainforests. Is it true that saying hippopotamuses three times super fast will land you in the Volta River? Probably not - but it is a great place for hippopotamuses sightings!

title: Panama
description: Explore the harmonious blend of nature and urban life in Panama, feeling the rhythm of the jungles and the buzz of the cosmopolitan vibes in each location!

title: Liechtenstein
description: Liechtenstein, the heart of the Alps, combines its royal heritage with natural beauty. Traverse through its beautiful valleys and explore its cultural landmarks to experience a blend of history, culture, and stunning alpine adventure.

title: Curaçao
description: Curaçao being the C of the ABC islands in the southernmost corner of the Caribbean is actually, kind of, part of the European Union, this since the island is an overseas territory of the Netherlands. The capital Willemstad adds a pop of color with Dutch architecture. Learn a few words of papiamento, nibble on a chicken of the trees and snorkel away in the emerald waters!

title: Lesotho
description: Lesotho might be a tiny country landlocked in South Africa nevertheless exhibits remarkable world records - like being the highest country situated at 1400 meters and the world record high abseil of 204 meters at Maletsunyane Falls!

title: Bhutan
description: A landlocked country in the Himalayas with no traffic lights and a government that thinks more about GNH than GDP. Want to mountain climb? Stick to mountains below 6000 meters as above is banned. Gangkhar Puensum is the highest unclimbed mountain in the world and will likely stay unclimbed in the interest of local spiritual beliefs. Hint: do you see a phallic image, you're probably in this area.

title: United States Virgin Islands
description: Set sail for St. Thomas, St. John and St. Croix - the three main islands of the US Virgin Islands in the Caribbean Sea. In the mood for a sea adventure? Head for St. John and the Underwater National Park in Trunk Bay! More of a landlubber? Crab racing in St. Croix might be more up your alley!

title: Rwanda
description: Let’s explore ”the land of a thousand hills”. Rwanda is known for its diverse animal fauna with one of the highlights being the mountain gorilla. It also has four different national parks. Welcome to Rwanda!

title: Eswatini
description: Eswatini is an absolute monarchy and King Sobhuza II holds the world record for longest reigning monarch, 82 years and 253 days between 1899 to 1982. Dance and music are a large part of the Swazi culture, partake by visiting one of many festivals and events!

title: American Samoa
description: Start off your tropical adventure in the capital city Pago Pago located on the island Tutuila, hike up Mount Alava for breathtaking views and keep an eye out for flying foxes! Well, that's actually a kind of bat, one of three native mammals on the islands. Come here, learn more about Fa'a Samoa - the Samoan Way - and wind down on Two Dollar Beach.

title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
description: From the cobbled streets of Sarajevo to the emerald waters of Mostar, this map captures a land shaped by history and nature. Get ready for winding roads, steep peaks, and warm Balkan charm at every turn.

title: Northern Mariana Islands
description: The Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, or CNMI for short, consists of 14 more or less volcanic islands in the northwestern Pacific Ocean of which Saipan, Tinian and Rota are the most populated. The islands have a lot of history, from prehistoric eras to modern day and age. Set sail for this tropical pearl, immerse the history and guzzle in lemmai, mangga and bilimbi!

title: São Tomé and Príncipe
description: Nestled in the Gulf of Guinea, São Tomé and Príncipe offers stunning landscapes and rich cultural heritage. Wander through cocoa plantations, relax on serene beaches, and explore vibrant local markets. An island adventure awaits!

title: Namibia
description: Namibia doesn’t give away its secrets easily. Sparse signs, epic skies, and a whole lot of nothing between the something. Trust your gut, guess smart, and enjoy the ride.

title: Oman
description: Oman's unspoiled beaches, dramatic cliffs, and serene deserts create a stunning backdrop for any traveler. Delve into the country's rich history, marvel at its traditional architecture, and let the enchanting landscapes inspire your wanderlust!

title: Nepal
description: Temples, tea houses, and towering peaks. Nepal blends ancient tradition with jaw-dropping landscapes. Explore ancient city squares, spot colorful stupas, and wander roads that wind into the clouds. How well do you know this rooftop of the world?

title: Costa Rica
description: Rainforests, volcanoes, and coastlines that stretch forever. Costa Rica is small in size but massive in biodiversity. One round might land you in a misty jungle, the next beside a bright blue beach. Get ready to guess your way through pura vida.

title: Cyprus
description: Sharp turns in the hills, palm trees by the sea, and narrow streets filled with color. Cyprus challenges your eye with both natural beauty and small details that reveal where you are.

title: Paraguay
description: From Asunción's busy streets to peaceful rural paths, Paraguay keeps you guessing. Follow the colors, watch the poles, and trust your explorer instincts.
